a11y_label: MAD Launcher nav gajerun hanyoyin kewayawa
a11y_description: MAD Launcher yana amfani da damar kawai don kiyaye sanarwa da maɓallan saiti masu sauri akan mashin kewayawa yayin da kuke amfani da wasu ƙa'idodi. Ba ya karanta abun cikin allonku.
action_box_words_hint: Kalmomi a kowane harshe da ke gudanar da wannan umarni
action_box_commands_intro: Matsa umarni don gyara kalmominsa da aikace-aikacen sa. Kuna iya cire ginanniyar gajerun hanyoyin Ingilishi tare da ×.
action_box_commands_hub_sub: Umarni, injin bincike, da amsoshi nan take
action_box_instant_answers_sub: Amsoshi masu sauri daga gidan yanar gizo
action_box_command_at_sub: Saƙo da aikace-aikacen imel, da kalmomi kamar saƙo da imel
action_box_command_apps_words_sub: Aikace-aikace akan wannan umarni da gajerun hanyoyin harshe
action_box_command_words_only_sub: Gajerun hanyoyin harshe — matsa × don cire hatta ginannun na ciki
action_box_command_search_sub: Apps tare da ainihin akwatin nema na in-app
action_box_command_help_sub: /h gajeriyar hanya. Tagar taimako tana ƙarƙashin Extras → Gwaji
action_box_command_update_sub: Yana buɗe GetApps ko Play Store don haka zaka iya ɗaukaka duk
action_box_update_edit_hint: Buɗe jerin ɗaukakawar kantin. Android ba zai iya sabunta kowane app daga MAD ba tare da buɗe shagon ba.
action_box_search_edit_hint: : kawai jera kayan aikin da ke fallasa binciken cikin-app (Kalandar, YouTube, da makamantansu). Aikace-aikace ba tare da akwatin nema ba sun tsaya a waje.
action_box_search_none: Ba a sami aikace-aikacen da ake nema akan wannan wayar ba.
action_box_remove_builtin_hint: Matsa × don cire kalma, gami da ginanniyar gajerun hanyoyin Turanci kamar msg ko /h.
action_box_help_edit_hint: Tagan taimakon mai iyo yana tsayawa sai dai idan kun kunna shi a cikin Ƙari → Gwaji. /h an gyara shi anan.
action_box_open_updates_sub: GetApps ko Play Store - matsa Sabunta duk wurin
action_box_your_commands_hint: Rubuta kalmar gajeriyar hanya. Bude ƙa'ida, ko gudanar da haɗaɗɗiyar haɗaɗɗiyar sauri kamar @WhatsApp tare da lambar da aka riga aka zaɓa.
action_box_shortcut_pick_combo_app: Zaɓi aikace-aikacen don wannan haɗin gwiwa
action_box_on_this_phone_hint: Waɗannan dokokin ba sa buɗe wani app. Matsa kalma don canza ta (misali /s → m), × don cire ta, ko ƙara wata kalma.
action_box_command_words_hint: Kalmomi don ginanniyar umarni. Naku /d, yi, umarnin hoto suna cikin umarnin ku na sama.
action_box_no_apps_drag: Babu aikace-aikace - ƙara ko ja nan
action_box_all_apps_in_command: Kowane aikace-aikacen da aka shigar ya riga ya kasance a cikin wannan umarnin.
action_box_command_reminder_sub: Yana buɗe Agogo. /r milk in 20 min, ko pickup at 8pm
action_box_command_launcher_settings_sub: Abubuwan da aka fi so, da Saitin & izini.
action_box_command_abs_sub: Umarninku, ginanniyar kalmomi, jerin aikace-aikace, da izini.
action_box_pill_color_sub: Background of the dock pill and field
action_box_text_color_sub: Text and icons inside the pill
action_box_command_contact_sub: & then a name — pick who, then message or call
action_box_shortcut_need_words: Rubuta kalma ko / d, yi, manne hoto
action_box_shortcut_builtin: "%1$s" an riga an yi amfani da ginin ciki
action_box_shortcut_taken: "%1$s" an riga an yi amfani da shi
action_box_open_failed: Ba za a iya buɗe wannan app ɗin ba.
action_box_grants_intro: Akwatin Ayyuka yana buƙatar waɗannan izini don saƙo, kira, aikawa, da kuma adana sanda a kan allo
action_box_grant_overlay_why: Bayanan kula masu lanƙwasa tsaya a kan Launcher Microsoft
action_box_grant_listener_why: Hirar da aka yi kwanan nan a cikin @
help_add_command_desc: Saituna → Umurnin ku. Bude ƙa'ida, ko haɗakar sauri (@ / ! / #) tare da ƙa'idar da tuntuɓar da aka zaɓa.
settings_hub_docks_subtitle: Tsawo, gumaka, ɓoye ta atomatik, Akwatin Aiki da maɓallan Apps
extras_language_follows_system: Akwatin ayyuka yana amfani da yaren waya don menus da taimakon umarni.
no_matching_apps: Babu kayan aikin da aka shigar
allow_contacts_sublabel: Ana buƙatar zaɓar wanda za a aika
no_contacts_found: Ba a sami lambobin sadarwa ba
home_overlays_notif_access: Gida, mai rufi, damar sanarwa, damar
emergency_confirm: Yana buɗe dialer. Tabbatar a cikin aikace-aikacen wayar.
send_sms_direct: Aika ta %1$s ba tare da buɗe app ɗin ba
via_app_opens: Buɗe %1$s tare da shirye-shiryen rubutu (matsa Aika a can)
no_recent_conversations: Ba a sami tattaunawa kwanan nan a cikin %1$s tukuna
no_call_apps: Ba a sami aikace-aikacen kira ba.
actionbox_ott_calls_disabled: Messenger, Telegram, da sauran kiran app ba su da tallafi - matsa don cikakkun bayanai a Ba ya aiki.
translate_hint: Gwada: daga turanci zuwa spanish hello
translate_hint_word: Type the word, then pick a language below
translate_compose_banner: Fassara - rubuta rubutu, sannan zaɓi app
notes_compose_banner: Note - rubuta rubutu, sannan zaɓi app
ai_compose_banner: Tambayi AI - rubuta tambayarka, sannan zaɓi mataimaki
nav_compose_banner: Jeka - rubuta wuri, sannan zaɓi Maps ko Waze
note_press_enter: Danna Shigar don m, ko buga farko
placeholder_search_contacts: Bincika kwanan nan ko lambobin waya…
placeholder_pick_at: Zaɓi app, sannan a tuntuɓi don buɗewa…
placeholder_search_contacts_or_number: Bincika maganganun kwanan nan ko buga lamba…
placeholder_video_call: Bincika maganganun kwanan nan ko buga lamba don bidiyo…
placeholder_reminder: /r milk in 20 min, ko pickup at 8pm
placeholder_navigate: / g sannan wuri, ko kewayawa / je zuwa
type_reminded_of: Me kuke so a tunatar da ku?
granted_tap_to_open: An Ba da izini - taɓa don sake buɗewa
news_pick_sources: Zaɓi aikace-aikacen labarai da masu bugawa don cika wannan shafin.
news_no_stories: Babu labarai tukuna. Zaɓi tushe, ko buɗe app ɗin labarai don MAD ta karɓi kanun labaran sa.
notif_enable_access: Kunna damar sanarwar don gumakan da ba a karanta su ba
qs_hint_tap_replace: Matsar da tayal, matsa × don ɓoye, ko matsa tayal sannan akwai wanda zai maye gurbinsa.
qs_hint_tap_available: Matsa wani tayal da ke akwai don maye gurbin da aka yi fice.
recents_empty: Aikace-aikacen da kuka buɗe akan wannan wayar suna nunawa anan.
recents_usage_access_hint: Kunna damar amfani don haɗa ƙa'idodin da aka ƙaddamar daga wasu ƙa'idodin (jerin wayar kwanan nan).
setup_description: Ana buƙatar kunna wasu saitunan Android don MAD Launcher yayi cikakken aiki. Matsa mataki don tsalle kai tsaye zuwa gare shi.
setup_reopen_hint: Sake buɗe kowane lokaci tare da /ls → Izinin saitin &.
setup_row_home_title: Saita MAD Launcher azaman aikace-aikacen Gida
setup_row_home_why: Wannan shine ainihin abin da ke maye gurbin allon gida na hannun jari. Idan ba tare da shi ba, danna Gida ba zai haifar da ɗayan wannan ba.
setup_row_listener_title: Ba da izinin samun damar sanarwa
setup_row_listener_why: faɗakarwa ta gaske, gumakan da ba a karanta ba, ba da amsa ta taga, da guntun kafofin watsa labarai na dindindin duk suna buƙatar samun sanarwar.
setup_row_overlay_why: Kunna wannan don windows sanarwa masu yawo da bayanin kula na iya tsayawa kan sauran aikace-aikacen.
setup_row_a11y_title: Kunna dama ga gajerun hanyoyin kewayawa
setup_row_a11y_why: Ƙararrawar zagaye da kayan aiki suna zaune akan tsarin maɓalli 3 nav bar a cikin kowane app. Ba a karanta abun cikin allo.
setup_row_contacts_why: Action Box yana nuna zaren app na kwanan nan da farko, sannan lambobin wayarku don @ # *.
setup_row_post_why: Tunatarwa na gida daga MAD Launcher.
setup_row_battery_why: Keep yana sa mai sauraro da nav ya rufe daga kashe shi cikin shiru a bango.
setup_row_usage_why: Yana ba da damar Kwanan baya da Mafi yawan amfani da su sun haɗa da aikace-aikacen da aka buɗe daga wasu aikace-aikacen - jeri ɗaya da Android ke kiyayewa don allon bayyani.
setup_row_location_why: Wuri mai ƙarfi kawai, don haka widget din yanayin gida na iya nuna ainihin zafin jiki.
setup_row_read_sms_why: Fadawa lokacin da wayarka ba ta madubi SMS zuwa samun damar sanarwa - ƙididdige ƙididdigewa, saƙon MAD, da sautin faɗakarwa daga akwatin saƙo na SMS.
help_at_label: Saƙo ko imel ta hanyar app
help_app_search_desc: Buga: sai app alias (misali :yt). Ka'idodi kawai masu binciken in-app.
help_at_desc: Zaɓi saƙon ko aikace-aikacen imel, sannan lamba - Akwatin ayyuka yana buɗe wannan taɗi a shirye don bugawa. Laƙabi: txt, rubutu, msg, saƙo, mail, imel, aikawa.
help_social_desc: Zaɓi app ɗin zamantakewa da aka shigar (ciki har da Facebook) - Akwatin aiki yana buɗe mawaƙa. Babu bugu ta atomatik.
help_contact_lookup_desc: Rubuta & ko tuntuɓar sai Space - zaɓi mutum, sannan app don saƙo ko kira.
help_group_desc: Nau'in? sai tambayar ku; zaɓi mataimaki idan an shigar da yawa. Laƙabi: ai, tambaya ai.
no_ai_assistants: Ba a sami mataimakan AI ba. Shigar ChatGPT, Gemini, Claude, Copilot, ko makamantansu.
contact_lookup_banner: Nemo lamba, sannan saƙo ko kira
help_call_desc: Zaɓi aikace-aikacen kira (Waya, WhatsApp, Messenger,…), sannan tattaunawar kwanan nan. Laƙabi: bugun kira, kira, waya.
help_video_call_desc: Zaɓi aikace-aikacen kiran bidiyo, sannan tattaunawa kwanan nan. Laƙabi: vid, bidiyo.
help_note_desc: Rubuta /n sannan Space - zaɓi aikace-aikacen bayanin kula (Keep, da sauransu) kuma ƙirƙirar bayanin kula a wurin.
help_add_contact_desc: Rubuta / a ko ƙara lamba sannan Space - suna da lambar zaɓi, sannan zaɓi aikace-aikacen Lambobin sadarwa. Yana buɗe allon ƙara-lamba.
help_translate_desc: Rubuta /t, trans, ko fassara sannan Space - filin yana share rubutun ku. Na zaɓi: daga Ingilishi zuwa Spanish. Fassara yana gudana akan wannan wayar, ko zaɓi aikace-aikacen fassara.
help_sticky_desc: Ajiye bayanin kula akan allon gida. Baya buɗe wasu apps.
help_reminder_desc: Yana buɗe Agogo. /r ko remind, sannan milk in 20 min don mai ƙidayar lokaci, ko pickup at 8pm don ƙararrawa.
help_schedule_desc: Ayyuka, kwanan wata, da lokaci - saka kalanda.
help_launcher_settings_desc: Abubuwan da aka fi so, da Saitin & izini.
help_action_box_settings_desc: Umarninku, ginanniyar kalmomi, jerin aikace-aikace, da izini.
help_settings_search_desc: Mafi kyawun ƙoƙarin bincike na saitunan OEM.
help_update_desc: Yana buɗe GetApps ko Play Store akan jerin ɗaukakawa. Matsa Sabunta duk wurin - MAD ba zai iya shigar da sabuntawa a bango ba.
help_nav_desc: Rubuta / g ko tafi sai Space - filin yana share wuri. kewaya, kewaya, kuma tafi har yanzu aiki. Zaɓi Maps ko Waze idan an shigar.
dock_always_show_hint: Dock yana tsayawa akan allon gida.
dock_auto_hide_hint: Dock yana ɓoye tare da mashaya mai nuni. Share ko matsa sandar don buɗewa.
dock_auto_hide_bottom_warning: Wurin ja na iya tsoma baki tare da buɗe aljihun tebur.
dock_show_over_apps_hint: Keeps wannan tashar jirgin ruwa ko sandar ja a kan allo yayin da kuke amfani da wasu aikace-aikacen. Yana buƙatar izinin zana.
frequent_usage_access_hint: Kunna damar amfani don cikakken matsayi a cikin Android.
frequent_empty: Yi amfani da aikace-aikacen kuma MAD zai sanya mafi yawan aiki anan ta atomatik.
settings_gestures_hint: Alamar ƙaddamarwa da gajerun hanyoyin kewayawa suna cikin babban saiti.
settings_home_notif_description: Aikace-aikacen gida, damar sanarwa, mai rufewa, samun dama, lambobin sadarwa, da baturi.
settings_nav_description: Wannan ƙaddamarwa yana amfani da maɓallin kewayawa 3. Ba a tallafawa kewayawa karimci.
settings_unapplied_body: Kuna da canje-canje waɗanda ba a yi amfani da su ba tukuna.
settings_hub_fonts_subtitle: Tsarin ko fayil ɗin rubutu na al'ada
settings_hub_not_working_subtitle: Abubuwan da aka iyakance akan wannan na'urar
settings_hub_experimental_subtitle: MAD windows, Kwanan baya, da gajerun hanyoyin kewayawa
settings_experimental_intro: Waɗannan abubuwan ƙari sun maye gurbin tsarin Kwanan baya, inuwar sanarwa, da Saituna masu sauri. An kashe su ta tsohuwa saboda basa aiki da dogaro akan yawancin wayoyi.
settings_experimental_mad_windows: Fadakarwa na MAD da Saitunan Saurin windows
settings_experimental_mad_windows_off: Kashe: Fadakarwa suna buɗe inuwar sanarwar. Saituna masu sauri suna buɗe inuwa mai tsayi (daidai da swiping sau biyu).
settings_experimental_mad_windows_on: Kunna: Saƙonni, Tsarin & apps, da Saituna masu sauri suna buɗe windows na MAD maimakon inuwar tsarin.
settings_experimental_help_window_off: Kashe: /h an gyara shi a ƙarƙashin Gyara tashar jiragen ruwa/s → Saitunan ActionBox. Babu taga taimako mai iyo.
settings_experimental_help_window_on: Kunnawa: /h yana buɗe lissafin umarni akwatin Ayyuka.
settings_experimental_widget_badges_off: Off: the MAD clock widget does not show unread app icons.
settings_experimental_widget_badges_on: On: unread app icons appear on the MAD clock widget.
settings_experimental_mad_recents_off: Kashe: Kwanan baya (fitar da ayyuka na kwanan nan) yana buɗe Siffofin wayar.
settings_experimental_mad_recents_on: Kunnawa: Kwanan baya yana buɗe taga na kwanan nan-app na MAD. Samun damar amfani ya cika lissafin daga wasu ƙa'idodi.
settings_experimental_nav_shortcuts_off: Kashe: babu maɓallan da aka rufe akan mashin ɗin, kuma MAD baya sata taps na nav. Ana ajiye wuraren ajiya.
settings_experimental_nav_shortcuts_on: Kunnawa: Maɓallai masu rufewa da taps nav suna amfani da wuraren da kuke. Gyara su a ƙasa.
settings_experimental_need_grants_body: Wannan yana buƙatar ƙarin izini. Bude kowane tallafin da ya ɓace, sannan ku dawo nan. Soke barin shi.
compat_upload_body: Sunan zaɓi, imel, da bayanin kula. Tabbatar da aika .txt da .json zuwa babban fayil rahotanni na MAD GitHub.
platform_intro: MAD ya dace da OS na wayarka. Iyakantattun fasalulluka suna kasancewa masu amfani amma ƙila ba za su yi kama da inuwar hannun jari daidai ba.
platform_partial_sync_title: Sashe na aiki tare akan wannan na'urar
platform_partial_sync_body: Wasu faɗakarwa na iya yin daidai da ma'aunin matsayi a wannan ROM. Korewa a cikin MAD na iya zama ba zai share inuwar tsarin ba.
platform_view_not_working: Duba cikakkun bayanai a cikin saitunan marasa aiki
platform_permissions_warning: fasalin %1$d sun iyakance akan wannan na'urar. Matsa don cikakkun bayanai.
setup_row_xiaomi_autostart_why: Ka'idar tsaro autostart yana riƙe da sanarwa da gajerun hanyoyin kewayawa da rai bayan sake kunnawa.
setup_row_xiaomi_battery_why: HyperOS yakan kashe masu sauraren bango. Saita MAD zuwa amfani da baturi mara iyaka.
compat_selftest_waiting: Kammala izinin da ake buƙata a sama - sannan MAD tana gudanar da gwajin dacewa da kai anan.
compat_selftest_subtitle: Helps MAD learn what works on your phone. Re-runs as you grant permissions. Report is optional but appreciated.
compat_notes_hint: Wani abu kuma baya aiki? (na zaɓi)
compat_github_hint: Sake duba kawai yana sake gudanar da binciken. Upload yana aika gwajin kai-da-kai zuwa rahoton GitHub/compat. Rahoton kwaro yana amfani da Extras.
settings_palette_hint: Tsarin yana bin duhu da haske na wayar. Nord da Wallpaper har yanzu suna canzawa tare da shi.
settings_landscape_rotate_hint: Layout stays put — nothing scales or slides. Icons and names turn together in place. MAD clock stays stacked (clock, date, weather) and fills its cell; wide third-party strips stay as drawn. Leave off on tablets.
settings_infinite_home_pages: Shafukan da ba su da iyaka
settings_infinite_home_pages_hint: Bayan shafi na ƙarshe, zazzage shi zuwa na farko (kuma akasin haka).
settings_page_grid_hint: Grid don shafukan gida, Mafi yawan amfani, da aljihunan app. Rufe kowane shafi a cikin menu na musamman.
settings_icon_size_hint: Girman gunkin cikin kowane grid cell akan shafukan gida, Mafi yawan amfani, da aljihunan app.
settings_icon_bg_hint: Fades the app’s own icon fill. The glyph stays solid.
settings_no_wallpaper_colors: Babu launin fuskar bangon waya da aka gano - saita fuskar bangon waya da farko.
settings_nav_classic_hint: Madaidaicin mashigin Android. Babu maɓallan masu rufin MAD.
settings_nav_bar_hint: Kujeru biyu akan mashaya nav; kari suna zaune a cikin inuwar matsayi. Matsa kibiya don musanya kujeru.
settings_preferred_apps_saved: Abubuwan da aka fi so da aka adana
gesture_landscape_enabled: Hannun motsi a cikin shimfidar wuri
gesture_landscape_enabled_hint: Kashe ta tsohuwa don haka grid na gida zai iya gungurawa a tsaye a cikin shimfidar wuri.
settings_hub_share_apk_subtitle: Link or QR for the public download APK
share_apk_hint: The GitHub download link only works if you are signed in to the private repo. Tap Send APK to share the public build (no distributor token) over WhatsApp, Nearby, or Bluetooth.
share_apk_send_failed: Could not prepare the public APK
extras_language_hint: Zaɓi fakitin harshe. Canje-canje na shafi nan da nan. Samo ƙarin fakitin zazzagewa daga babban fayil ɗin MAD GitHub lang.
extras_no_more_languages: An riga an shigar da duk fakitin da aka jera.
extras_message_hint: Sunan zaɓi da imel. Rubuta bug, ra'ayi, ko wani abu dabam.
dock_second_row_hint: Swipe up on the dock (not the home screen) to slide it up and show another row of 5 apps. Swipe up on the dock again for the app drawer.
dock_side_size_immediate: Girman dokin gefen yana aiki nan da nan (babu buƙatar buƙata).
dock_add_to_which: Ƙara zuwa wane tashar jirgin ruwa?
settings_shape_applies_immediately: Siffar tana aiki nan da nan zuwa gida, tashar jirgin ruwa, da aljihun tebur.
toast_updates_unavailable: Ba a sami kantin sayar da kayan aiki don sabuntawa ba
